items: Index projects record parcel, LTL costs. A third-quarter industry freight index projects parcel and LTL costs at record highs in Q4 2026, citing higher fuel costs, tight over-the-road capacity and rising parcel rates. It also said additional surcharge increases are expected into 2027.

Jefferies sees Amazon parcel network growing. The broker said Amazon could grow its US delivery stations from about 575 to 950 by 2030 and handle more third-party parcels now carried by UPS and USPS. Early trials reportedly show 20% to 25% savings for business-to-consumer shippers.

GLS US expands parcel service to El Paso. The carrier is extending its Texas network after launching in Houston, Austin and San Antonio in 2026 and Dallas-Fort Worth in 2025. GLS US handles parcels up to 150 pounds and offers international options; no rates were given.
